Title: Q: Chair of Hades and Ilomba

Messages.Author: Myrdin
Messages.Body:
If an Ilomba in play is the target of a chair of hades, does the
Ilomba get removed from the minion or is part of the "remove from
play" effect to burn the Ilomba thus making the minion burn a blood
instead?

Ilomba, Retainer, Laibon, R , [EK:R]
Animal with 1 life. Requires a Laibon. Put Ilomba on any minion (this
is a +1 stealth (D) action if that minion is controlled by another
Methuselah). If Ilomba would burn a life (or would otherwise be
burned), this minion burns a blood or life instead. If he or she
cannot, he or she is burned. A minion may have only one Ilomba.

Chair of Hades, Action, Necromancy, R , [LotN]
+1 stealth action.
[nec] (D) Remove a mortal or ghoul (retainer or ally) from the game.
[NEC] (D) Remove any non-wraith ally or retainer or vampire with
capacity less than 3 from the game.

/Ivan

Messages.Author: BeAst
Messages.Body:


I'd say just remove.
Ilombra's text says "If Ilomba would burn a life (or would otherwise
be burned)", chair says "Remove any non-wraith ally or retainer or

vampire with capacity less than 3 from the game."

Ilombra is removed from game, not burnt, so its text isn't enacted.
